title: Cosmic Sorceress with Planet
description: A hooded sorceress in a black starry robe stands with her back to the viewer, raising a staff topped with a golden symbol toward a large blue and orange planet encircled by golden rings. The planet is surrounded by a flowing purple cosmic serpent-like creature with multiple grotesque hooded faces, open mouths, and dripping pink liquid, set against a dark space background with constellations and glowing orbs.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a hooded sorceress in a long black robe decorated with white stars and symbols, standing with her back to the viewer and raising a staff with a golden symbol toward a large detailed planet with blue oceans and orange landmasses encircled by glowing golden rings. A massive flowing purple cosmic serpent creature with multiple grotesque hooded faces, open screaming mouths, and dripping pink liquid wraps around the planet. Dark space background with constellations, glowing orbs, and floating golden rings on the ground.
